pluginsChangeFailed: Plugin change was not confirmed. Refresh and check its state.
pluginOpenLinkFailed: Could not open the source link.
pluginCredentialNeeded: Save a credential to enable this server.
pluginConnectionSaveFailed: Connection change was not confirmed. Refresh and try again.
pluginOAuthIntro: Choose a workspace and approve access in your browser.
pluginGitHubOAuthIntro: Install Caelis Bot on selected repositories, then authorize it in your browser. Bot can read and update code, issues and pull requests in those repositories. The code stays in this app.
pluginGitHubOAuthSetup: Browser sign-in requires a registered GitHub App client ID with Device Flow enabled. A personal access token remains available below.
pluginGitHubOAuthFailed: GitHub authorization did not complete. You can try again.
pluginToolsPreview: Tool preview; this Runtime has not started the server.
pluginSyncFailed: Plugin changes were saved, but connection is incomplete.
loginAtLoginUnavailable: Could not read the login item.
loginAtLoginLoadFailed: Could not read the login item. Try again.
loginAtLoginChangeFailed: Could not change the login item. Try again.
languageSaveFailed: Could not save the language. Try again.
languageLoadFailed: Could not load the language preference. Choose a language to save it again.
sizeLoadFailed: Could not load the character size.
sizeSaveFailed: Could not save the character size. Try again.
notificationTestBody: This is a Caelis Bot notification preview.
notificationTestFailed: Could not send the test notification.
taskSnapshotsReady: Screen access is available. Opening or switching a terminal can cache a local still. No continuous recording or upload.
taskSnapshotsPermission: macOS screen capture permission is needed for previews. Without it, cards show terminal icons. Only local stills are captured, with no continuous recording or upload. Permission changes may require restarting Bot.
taskSnapshotSettingsFailed: Could not open screen capture permission settings.
updateCheckFailed: Could not check for updates. Try again or visit the release page.
autoUpdateDescription: Checks daily for official releases and notifies you when an update is available.
updateWaiting: Update is ready. Saving work and preparing to restart.
updatePreparing: Saving pending decisions, work, and original receipts for restart…
updateClosing: Closing this app's connections before installation…
updateNoteAvailable: Once confirmed, the app verifies and installs the update and restarts, preserving conversations, notes, and settings.
updateNoteManual: In-app updates are not enabled for this build. Download releases from the release page.
importContentPackDescription: Add custom or authorized characters and avatars
packInUseHint: Switch away from active character or avatar first
shortcutGlobalDescription: Brings chat to front when in background or minimized; hides chat when pressed while focused
shortcutRecordingAria: Press new global shortcut, Escape to cancel
shortcutInvalidPrompt: Use Control, Option/Alt, or Command plus Space, letter, digit, or F1–F12
executionIntro: Control how the Bot asks for confirmation when taking actions.
executionSaveFailed: Could not confirm save outcome. Reload permission settings to verify.
executionModeUnavailable: This setting is not provided by the current runtime
executionNote: Work sessions follow the permission and approval rules of the active runtime.
storageLoadFailed: Could not read attachment storage. Try again.
storageCleanSuccess: Older attachment copies moved to Trash.
storageCleanFailed: Could not clean storage. Try again.
diagnosticsExportFailed: Could not export diagnostic report. Try again.
storageConfirmPrompt: Older copies will be moved to Trash. They may need to be re-added if referenced again. Original files and chat history are preserved.
diagnosticsReportDescription: Saved locally only; excludes chat content and credentials
maxBackgroundTasksHelp: Default: 6. Applies to work started or resumed by the Bot. Lowering this limit does not stop existing work.
externalTerminalHelp: Used when opening a task from the watchlist.
taskPreferencesSaveFailed: Could not save. Edit the value to try again.
customTerminalHelp: Use {script} as a separate argument. Compatibility is not guaranteed; configure and verify your command. Shell operators are not expanded.
taskShortcutDescription: Hold to show pinned task previews. Move the pointer to keep them open; click to open or bring a terminal forward, or collapse it when supported. Previews do not start terminals.
permissionIntroduction: Enable the permissions you need for desktop tasks.
permissionAccessibilityHelp: Let Bot read application interfaces, click controls and enter text for your tasks.
permissionScreenHelp: Capture screen content, preview task windows and optionally provide window images for Bot tasks.
permissionAutomationHelp: Allow supported terminals to create a task connection through their native interface.
permissionNotificationsHelp: Receive task reminders and items that need your attention.
permissionRepairHelp: If an existing entry does not work, check that it is this running copy. If needed, reset one permission and grant access again.
permissionDevelopment: Rebuilding a development copy can invalidate earlier grants. Check the app path when development and installed copies share the same name.
permissionResetScope: Reset revokes this category for the current user and every copy of this Caelis Bot application ID, including other versions. Automation resets all terminal grants. macOS cannot select only an old version.
permissionResetConfirm: I understand existing grants in this category will be revoked and must be enabled again
permissionResetDone: Reset complete. Reopen Bot, then enable this permission here.
permissionLoadFailed: Could not read system permissions. Reopen Settings to try again.
permissionActionFailed: The permission action did not complete. Check the system prompt or expand the repair help below.
permissionSwitchHelp: Change this permission in system settings.
permissionRequested: Complete the system permission prompt. If none appears, continue in System Settings.
permissionRefreshNeeded: macOS accepted the request. If the status has not updated, quit Bot from its menu and relaunch the same build. Reopening a window does not restart the app.
permissionNeedsSettings: Access has not been granted. Enable it in System Settings, then return.
permissionChangeInSystem: Turn this permission off in System Settings.
permissionPrivacyBody: For desktop tasks, Bot sends the observed window’s text, controls and on-demand screenshots to your connected AI service. You still choose whether to send manual captures; terminal previews stay on this Mac. Bot does not continuously record your screen or capture audio.
permissionMissingApp: Caelis Bot missing from the list? Use the + button in Accessibility or Screen Recording to add the running copy shown below. Locate it in Finder first. Automation requires a system request for the selected terminal.
captureShortcutDescription: F1 captures or asks Bot about a selection; F3 pins an image.
pasteShortcutDescription: Pin the selected capture or an image from the clipboard.
captureShortcutInvalid: Use F1–F12, or a key with Control, Option or Command.
screenContext: Include the complete screen for Bot
screenContextDescription: Include the rest of the screen by default when asking about a capture. You can change this before each send.
screenPreferencesFailed: Could not read or save screen preferences. Try setting the switch again.
permissionOptionalIntro: Choose the system access you need. You can change it later in Settings.
setupExtrasIntro: Choose whether to use quick capture and pin tools.
setupExtrasLater: Chat attachments still work when this is off. Change it later in Settings → Extras.
setupExtrasLoadFailed: Could not read the current choice. Try again to continue.
setupExtrasSaveFailed: Could not save your choice. Try Continue again.
previewFailed: Preview unavailable. Your desktop character is unchanged.
machineSubtitle: Connect a machine, then set up its own runtime.
machineEmpty: Work runs on this computer by default. Connect another machine when you need it.
machineAliasHint: An existing SSH alias also works. A directly entered address needs no alias.
machineTrustNote: Compare this fingerprint with the machine’s host key before connecting.
machineIndependent: This setting applies to this machine. Accounts and credentials stay here.
machineInstallTitle: Install a runtime on this machine
machineInstallNote: Open the remote terminal to install Codex or Caelis, then check again.
machineCodexLoginNote: Open the remote TUI to sign in. For ChatGPT, you can also run codex login --device-auth there and follow its link. Return here and check again.
machineCaelisLoginNote: Complete model sign-in in this machine’s Caelis TUI, then return and check again.
machineTeamOptional: A custom Team is optional. Default workers can work without it.
machineAdvancedTUI: OAuth, ACP and other advanced flows currently need to be completed in this machine’s Caelis TUI.
machineAdvancedFailed: Advanced settings could not be read. You can keep working and configure them in the TUI.
machineCanStart: You can assign work from chat.
machineActionFailed: The action could not be confirmed. Check the connection and try checking again.
machineError_invalid_address: Enter a hostname or IP address.
machineError_invalid_key: Choose an existing private key file with an absolute path.
machineError_unreachable: This machine could not be reached. Check its address, port and network.
machineError_ssh_authentication_or_conne: SSH could not connect. Check your username, authentication and network, then reconnect.
machineError_host_key_changed: The host key has changed. The previous connection is preserved. Verify the machine outside this app before reconnecting.
machineError_machine_has_tasks: This machine owns tasks. Keep its SSH connection to access them. You can change the work tool at any time.
machineError_unsupported_ssh_route: Multi-hop ProxyJump and scripted ProxyCommand connections are not supported. Use a direct connection or a single existing jump host.
machineError_unsupported_platform: This version supports Linux machines with x86_64 or arm64 CPUs.
machineError_target_identity_changed: The remote machine identity has changed. Original tasks will not be moved or restarted.
machineError_ssh_control_directory_inval: The private SSH connection folder could not be used. Reopen the app and try again.
machineError_keychain_delete_failed: Could not remove the saved SSH credential from Keychain. Try again.
machineModelsUnavailable: Models could not be loaded. Check the connection again.
approvalAutoHelp: Keep the workspace write sandbox; Codex reviews requests for additional access.
approvalAskHelp: Keep the workspace write sandbox and ask you to confirm additional access.
approvalReadOnlyHelp: Local commands use a read-only sandbox without requesting elevated access. Connectors and Bot tools retain their own authorization rules.
approvalFullAccessHelp: Disable the command sandbox and execution approval prompts. Use only when you explicitly need this.
approvalGuardianHelp: Guardian reviews additional access for new conversations. The sandbox stays enabled; existing conversations keep their original review settings.
machineNoSSH: No connections found. Create a new connection, or add an SSH config and refresh.
machineReuseSSHNote: Uses the user, port, keys and jump host from your local SSH config.
machineError_ssh_config_read_failed: Could not read SSH config. Check the files and refresh, or create a new connection.
machineError_ssh_config_host_missing: This SSH config no longer exists. Refresh and choose a connection.
machineConfigConnectFailed: Could not connect with this SSH config. Check it in your terminal; if a password or key passphrase is needed, enter it under Optional connection settings.
machineRemoveNote: Only removes the connection from Bot. Local SSH config, remote files and work tools are kept.
machineError_ssh_host_verification_faile: SSH host verification failed. Reconnect and check the host fingerprint. If using a jump host, also check that it is trusted.
messagingIntro: Keep chatting with the same Bot from another device.
extrasIntro: Capture and pin images on this computer. Chat attachments and desktop tasks have separate controls.
extrasCaptureDescription: F1 captures or asks Bot; F3 pins an image. Turning this off stops these actions.
machinePageIntro: Connect a remote machine and set up its work tools and accounts.
workerSwitchNote: Existing tasks keep their original work tool.
localWorkerModelNote: Default model for new local tasks
workerSetupRequired: Set up this work tool in AI accounts first.
weixinSubtitle: Chat with your assistant on Weixin
weixinDescription: Connect one private Weixin chat to this Caelis Bot.
weixinStartHelp: Get a pairing code, then scan it yourself in Weixin on your phone. Keep this Mac online.
weixinScanHelp: Open Weixin on your phone and scan this code. It expires after about five minutes.
weixinScannedHelp: Scan received. Finish the confirmation on your phone, then return here.
weixinVerifyLabel: Verification code shown on your phone
weixinConfirmHelp: Is {account} your Weixin account? Only this account's private text messages can reach Caelis Bot.
weixinHelp_blocked: Verification was blocked. Get a new code and follow the prompt on your phone.
weixinHelp_bound_elsewhere: This bot is already bound elsewhere. Check your Weixin connection before trying again.
weixinConnectedHelp: Send a private text message to the connected ClawBot. Final replies appear here and in Weixin when delivery succeeds. Keep Caelis Bot running and this Mac online. Approvals remain on the Mac.
weixinPausedHelp: Weixin messages are paused. Your pairing remains saved on this Mac.
weixinForgetHelp: This deletes the local pairing and token. It does not revoke access on Weixin; remove the ClawBot connection in Weixin separately if needed.
weixinIssue_network: Cannot reach Weixin. Check your connection; polling will retry.
weixinIssue_pairing_failed: Pairing could not finish. Check the code and try again.
weixinIssue_storage: Private local state could not be saved. Check disk space before using this channel.
weixinIssue_credential: The local Weixin credential could not be read or saved. Check the private data file or pair again if migration failed.
weixinIssue_auth_expired: The Weixin session expired. Remove the local connection and pair again.
weixinIssue_session_cooldown: The Weixin session is temporarily unavailable. Requests are paused and will retry after one hour; pairing is retained.
weixinIssue_remote_error: Weixin rejected an update request. The connection will retry.
weixinIssue_backlog: Incoming messages are waiting for this Mac. Check Bot setup and connection.
weixinIssue_input_uncertain: A message submission is uncertain. Check the original request on your Mac before sending it again.
weixinIssue_delivery_retrying: Reply delivery is unconfirmed. Bot is making bounded retries (three total attempts); duplicate replies may appear in Weixin.
weixinIssue_delivery_uncertain: Reply delivery is still unconfirmed after three attempts. It may be duplicated or missing; check Weixin and your Mac.
weixinIssue_send_rejected: Weixin rejected a reply. Check the connection.
weixinIssue_untrusted_api_host: Weixin returned an unexpected server address. Pairing stopped to protect the token.
telegramCreate1: Open the verified @BotFather in Telegram and send /newbot.
telegramCreate2: Choose a name, then a unique username ending in bot (for example MyCaelisHelperBot).
telegramCreate3: Copy the API token BotFather gives you and paste it below.
telegramExisting: Already have a Bot? Send /mybots to BotFather, select it and choose API Token. Stop its connection in the previous app before switching.
telegramTokenPrivacy: Saved only on this device. Keep the token private.
telegramPairStep: Open @{bot} below, then tap Start in Telegram.
telegramPairWaiting: After tapping Start, return here to confirm your account. Only your confirmed private chat can send messages to Caelis Bot. The pairing link expires after 15 minutes.
telegramTakeOver: Switch this Bot to Caelis Bot
telegramStayOnline: Keep Caelis Bot running and this computer online. Closing chat keeps the connection active.
telegramIssue_invalid_token: This token is invalid. Copy the API Token from BotFather again.
telegramIssue_network: Cannot reach Telegram. Check your network or system proxy; Caelis Bot will reconnect automatically.
telegramIssue_occupied: Another app is using this Bot. Stop its Telegram connection, then try again.
telegramIssue_webhook: This Bot receives messages through another service. Switching will disconnect that service and discard its old pending Telegram messages.
telegramIssue_credential: Cannot access the local Telegram credential. Paste the bot token again if migration failed.
telegramIssue_storage: Cannot save connection state. Check available disk space and restart Caelis Bot.
telegramIssue_blocked: Unblock the Bot in Telegram, then connect again.
telegramIssue_unavailable: Telegram setup is unavailable. Restart Caelis Bot and try again.
telegramIssue_setup_failed: Could not finish setup. Try again.
telegramIssue_open_failed: Could not open Telegram. Open the Bot from Telegram manually.
telegramIssue_pairing_failed: Could not create a pairing link. Try connecting again.
telegramIssue_pairing_expired: The pairing link has expired. Try connecting again to get a new link.
telegramIssue_delivery_uncertain: A message delivery could not be confirmed. It will not be duplicated automatically; check Telegram and your Mac.
telegramIssue_file_delivery_uncertain: A file delivery could not be confirmed. Check Telegram before sending it again.
telegramIssue_file_unavailable: A file could not be shared. Check the original attachment on your Mac.
telegramIssue_rate_limited: Telegram is busy. Message updates will resume shortly.
telegramIssue_telegram_error: Telegram rejected an update. Check the Bot connection.
telegramIssue_approval_unavailable: An approval has no readable choices in Telegram. Complete it in Caelis Bot on your Mac.
telegramIssue_sync_busy: Too many files are waiting to sync. Check Telegram before resending missing files.
telegramCreateSimple: BotFather will help you create a Bot and give you its token. Choose a name and a username ending in bot.
telegramConfirmHelp: Only the account you confirm on this Mac can send work to your assistant.
telegramPausedHelp: Messages from Telegram are paused. Your Bot and saved account stay in place.
telegramConnectingHelp: Checking the connection. Keep this window open until the result appears.
telegramWebhookChoice: Paste the token again if needed, then choose whether to move this Bot from its previous service.
telegramForgetHelp: This removes the saved account and token from Caelis Bot. It does not delete your Telegram Bot.
